name: Syncly Social
description: Bring Syncly's social intelligence into Claude. Search brand mentions across social, including video. Track sentiment and mention volume over time, surface top creators, keywords, and trends, and rank posts by performance to see what is working.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Syncly Social to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Syncly Social to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.syncly.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Syncly Social MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Syncly Social lists 13 MCP tools, including get_metric_summary, get_period_change, get_post_details, get_post_features, get_posts_by_ids, get_ranked_posts, get_top_influencers, get_top_terms, list_data_queries, list_workspaces, search_posts, and search_posts_by_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Syncly Social?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Syncly Social in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Syncly Social MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Syncly Social requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Syncly Social is developed by Syncly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
